The '''Assault on Vardoss IV''' was a famous battle won by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Vardoss IV]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> It was the final battle of the [[Ciutric Offensive]], a campaign of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] that took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Aftermath==
In later years, the victory would be one of many that a player could simulate on [[Plescinia Entertainments/Legends|Plescinia Entertainments]]' [[CS-Mark 10]].<ref name="GFT" />
